blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The organizers of the Sept. 21 anti-corruption rally near Mendiola said their show of force was a success despite “fear mongering” and “overkill measures” from the police and Malacañang. Thousands of protesters marched from Liwasang Bonifacio to the vicinity of Mendiola Peace Arch to mark the 54th anniversary of martial law declaration as well as the second iteration of the anti-corruption protests prompted by the multibillion flood control corruption scandal. “We were able to gather thousands of people despite the fear-mongering of the police and Malacañang,” said Mong Palatino, Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) secretary-general, in a message to […]...
